reviews.text:
5 star review is my way of saying Thank You to the team at
Mr. Pool Leak Repair!  I recently noticed a leak in the pool. This is the 2nd time and I refuse to call the company I used last time. My neighbor recommended Mr. Pool Leak Repair so I gave them a call.
My schedule changes from day to day so I thought scheduling a day and time might be a ways out but Laura fit me in for the next day without a problem. Justin arrived early and within an hour was done and cleaning up to go. I thought he was leaving and coming back another day but he was done! He showed me what the issue was and how he repaired it. The work was guaranteed and the cost wasn't astronomical.  Excellent service i will definitely recommend to my neighbors. Thanks again Mr. Pool Leak Repair!!

reviews.text:
If your pool is acting up in Frisco, don’t even think twice, call Mr Pool Leak Repair!

Cody and Justin came out first, and these guys are like the Sherlock Holmes of leak detection. They found the problem faster than I could say “my pool is crying.” Super professional, super friendly, and they explained everything clearly.

Then Nacho, and Juan handled the repair, and honestly… it was like watching a pit crew at the Indy 500. Quick, clean, and precise. They even left the area looking better than they found it.

Overall? A+ experience. Great service, great crew, and my pool is finally leak-free and happy again. Highly recommend Mr Pool Leak Repair!

Pool Leak Detection & Repair in Frisco, TX When your pool starts losing water faster than normal, you need answers. Mr. Pool Leak Repair provides professional pool leak detection and repair services throughout Frisco, Texas, helping homeowners in this fast-growing city protect their pools from the challenging soil conditions of North Texas. Schedule Your Leak Detection Now 469-272-8624 Expert staff verified by Built To Last Our Repair Warranties Every repair includes a written warranty — some of the strongest in Frisco, Texas * Lifetime Warranty on Structural Crack Repairs 5 Year Warranty on Pipe Repairs 6 Year Warranty on Seal Repairs Trust The Experts. Why Frisco's Explosive Growth Doesn't Change Its Soil Challenges Frisco has transformed from a small railroad town to one of America’s fastest-growing cities, with a population now exceeding 220,000. Located at the intersection of Collin and Denton Counties, approximately 30 miles north of downtown Dallas, Frisco has become a premier destination for families drawn to its top-rated schools, professional sports venues, and master-planned communities. The city’s modern developments feature some of the finest homes in the metroplex—and an abundance of backyard pools. But even the newest pools in Frisco sit on the same high-movement clay soil that has challenged construction throughout North Texas for generations. According to the U.S. Department of Agriculture, the area covering Dallas through Collin and Denton counties contains over 50% clay content—among the highest in the country. This expansive clay soil contains smectite minerals that absorb water and swell, then shrink as they dry. The resulting soil movement can exert up to 15,000 pounds per square foot of pressure on structures. FEMA estimates this type of soil movement causes over $7 billion in damage annually across the nation. For pool owners, this means constant stress on pool shells, plumbing connections, and equipment. The same forces that cause foundation problems in homes also affect in-ground pools—cracking shells, separating fittings, and damaging underground plumbing. We Fix It & Guarantee It Backed by industry-leading warranties. Book Leak Detection Why Choose Us Why Frisco Homeowners Choose Mr. Pool Leak Repair Choosing the right pool repair company makes all the difference. Here’s why homeowners choose us again and again Fast scheduling and on-time arrival Accurate detection with advanced tools Repairs that last — backed by written warranties Licensed & insured technicians High satisfaction and 5-star reviews across DFW Book Leak Detection Warning Signs Your Frisco Pool May Have a Leak Not sure if your pool is leaking or just evaporating? Some water loss is normal in Texas heat, but watch for these warning signs: Water level dropping more than ¼ inch per day Needing to add water more than once per week Cracks appearing in the pool deck or coping Wet or soggy areas in your yard near the pool Algae growth despite proper chemical maintenance Increased water bills without explanation Air bubbles in the return lines Pool equipment losing prime frequently If you’re experiencing any of these issues, don’t delay. What starts as a small leak can quickly become a major structural problem—affecting your pool, your deck, and potentially your home’s foundation. from minor fixes to major overhauls We’re a full-service pool leak detection and repair company, equipped to handle all your pool repair needs. Contact Us Today FAq’s Frequently Asked Questions My pool is only a few years old. Can it already have a leak? Yes. Even new pools in Frisco can develop leaks because the clay soil begins moving immediately after construction. As the soil goes through its first few seasonal cycles of expansion and contraction, new pools can experience settling, cracked shells, or separated fittings. We frequently service pools that are only 2-3 years old. How do I know if my pool is leaking or just evaporating? In Frisco’s climate, pools typically lose about ¼ inch of water per day to evaporation during hot summer months. If you’re losing more than that, or if water loss continues at similar rates during cooler weather, you likely have a leak. The bucket test can help: place a bucket of pool water on your steps and compare water levels after 24 hours. How long does a typical repair take? It depends on the leak’s location and severity. Many repairs are completed same-day or within a few days. We’ll provide a clear timeline after diagnosis. Can you detect leaks in spa/hot tub combos? Yes, we regularly repair pools with attached spas. The connection points between pools and spas are actually common leak locations due to the different thermal expansion rates and soil movement. Get Your Frisco Pool Leak Fixed Today Stop watching your water disappear—and stop worrying about what damage it might be causing beneath the surface. The sooner you address a leak, the less damage it causes. Call today to learn more about how we can help you stop your pool from leaking. data.summary: The 8 Google reviews are highly detailed and emotionally authentic, reading like genuine customer experiences. However, the perfect 5.0 score with no critical feedback and the repetitive, promotional mention of staff names across multiple reviews raises mild suspicion of possible review solicitation or curation. There is no evidence of fake review patterns like same-day posting or generic language. The lack of presence on other review platforms (BBB, Yelp, Angi) limits cross-verification but is not unusual for a specialized local contractor.
fake_signals: All reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback
Multiple reviews mention the same staff names (Laura, Justin, Juan, Marco, Nacho, Cody, Christian) in a promotional tone
Some reviews have similar narrative structures (call, friendly dispatcher, punctual tech, quick fix, high praise)
authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific details: project types (pool leak), staff names, timelines (next day, within 3 hours), and outcomes (fixed leak, saved on water bill)
Varied writing styles and perspectives from different customers (home seller, new homeowner, repeat customer)
Emotional authenticity in expressing relief and gratitude
Mentions of real-world consequences (almost ruined summer, saving on water bill)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews are available, showing a perfect 5.0 rating. No other platforms have ratings to compare, so no discrepancy can be assessed.
